text: # MathDB frontier research

This phase responds to the user's correction: the objective is a genuinely new idea toward a significant named open problem, not another routine consequence of an accepted OpenAI theorem. The earlier F001–F010 remain archived deductions; they do not meet this phase's research target.
## Acceptance standard
1. Identify the exact MathDB problem and its remaining scope after accepting **all** the pinned OpenAI results.
2. Explain why the proposed result would matter for that problem. Cite an observed ranking or featured designation; never invent a score.
3. Identify a substantive new bridge: a construction, estimate, or structural lemma not already contained in a source or obtained by a standard transfer.
4. Try to prove the bridge and attack its vulnerable step with independent review, counterexamples, and appropriate exact or numerical checks.
5. Keep proved statements, conjectures, conditional reductions, and failed approaches visibly distinct. A reduced problem is not a solved problem. A computation is not a general proof.
6. Give each substantive validated finding its own commit. Do not inflate the finding count with equivalent formulations or routine corollaries.
## MathDB interpretation

The [database](https://mathdb.com/database) exposes Trending, Newest, Featured, and Likes. The [news archive](https://mathdb.com/news) exposes a Significance ordering. Indexed snapshots describe significance as a 0–100 estimate of **the impact of a reported development**, not proof certainty. These are not verified numerical rankings of every open problem.

For example, the indexed [Schubert-varieties homepage snapshot](https://mathdb.com/?tag=schubert-varieties) reports 97/100 for a forced Navier–Stokes announcement, 84/100 for a cscK Yau–Tian–Donaldson counterexample claim, 79/100 for a Pierce–Birkhoff counterexample claim, 76/100 for a bicentralizer/classification claim, and 75/100 for an Arnold–Givental claim. The snapshot was indexed three weeks before retrieval on 2026-10-08; these are historical news scores, not current scores for our proposed work.

The current homepage features Hodge, BSD, Riemann, Yang–Mills, P versus NP, Navier–Stokes, and the solved Poincaré conjecture. Featuring and numerical news significance must not be conflated. Browser access hit a Cloudflare verification page; readable search-index copies remain available. No submissions or claims have been posted to MathDB.
## Current work

**Eight substantial findings accepted; two remain.** [R014](findings/R014-uniform-coefficient-extraction.md) passes both independent gates and parent reproduction. [C66’s original proof passes](reviews/i67-logarithmic-blowup-r2.md), but [I68](reviews/i68-logarithmic-blowup-novelty.md) classifies it as technical only; its exactly explained parent-wrapper hash failures remain preserved. [I71](iterations/i71-global-variation-algebra-rounding.md) gives a linked strict-local-maximum obstruction and a cap-preserving spectral stopping certificate, with parent evidence PASS. AR remains unproved and unrefuted; further work needs a new global selection/stopping mechanism. [I70](iterations/i70-symplectic-geometry-discovery.md) leaves arbitrary-prefix relative ball packing unproved and unrefuted; its small-ball complement partial has fixed volume slack and is technical only. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I73](iterations/i73-arithmetic-geometry-discovery.md) records two incomplete constructions for minimal rank in polynomial twists, with parent provenance and finite-interface PASS; no substantial result is nominated. [I75](iterations/i75-polynomial-twist-selmer.md) independently audits the used prerequisites and gives a forced finite Selmer class, a one-level local-relaxation bound, the Gaussian restriction pairing loss, and actual rank-zero and sparse positive-rank twists. Parent reproduction passes; density and mean targets remain open and the branch is parked. [I72](iterations/i72-graph-probability-discovery.md) pays finite-switch symmetry and the entropy cost of rare girth conditioning but leaves the conditional spectral input open; its percolation extension is technical only. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I76](iterations/i76-logarithmic-girth-spectra.md) proves clean and fixed-positive-disorder spectra universality under logarithmic-girth conditioning and the stipulated premises. The clean proof uses rejection absorption and a weaker spectral interface with a log-determinant replacement for full rigidity. [I78](reviews/i78-logarithmic-girth-spectra-r2.md) passes both original proofs without substantive repairs; parent reproduction passes. [I79](reviews/i79-logarithmic-girth-spectra-novelty-r3.md) classifies A, B and the package as technical, with a concrete reduction to existing lower proof operations. Parent reproduction passes; the proof-verified spectral extension does not enter the substantial count. [I74](iterations/i74-relative-symplectic-packing.md) independently passes the used I70 arguments and constructs restricted transport and protected comparison models, with parent evidence PASS. Arbitrary relative packing remains open and is parked pending an adapted global construction. [I77](iterations/i77-weighted-switch-mixing.md) pays weighted pair-slice comparison and a complete matching-subclass flow, while two actual local counterexamples block unchanged weighted source estimates. Parent reproduction passes. The all-degree target is unproved and unrefuted, and parked pending a new aggregate or encoding argument. [I80](iterations/i80-geometric-flows-computation-discovery.md) proposes C80: compact velocity, pressure and solenoidal forcing with rapid decay and exact particle computation on fixed Euclidean space. [I85](reviews/i85-compact-solenoidal-computation-r2.md) passes the original proof without repairs, including all-degree pressure cancellation, small-angle gates, loading, global derivative/support budgets and effective evaluation. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I86](reviews/i86-compact-solenoidal-computation-novelty-r3.md) completes the strongest relevant fluid-companion comparison and classifies C80 as TECHNICAL through a complete effective moving compact-Euler-template reduction. I85 resolves the original-proof condition; no finding is added. Parent reproduction preserves the frozen verifier’s inventory-order failure and passes its separate read-only ordering correction with all sealed bytes unchanged. The equivariant geometric and sharp cap-scale targets remain unresolved. [I81](iterations/i81-diophantine-approximation-discovery.md) completes a Diophantine gap report with author-level technical Catalan bounds and parent evidence PASS; finite irrationality measure remains unproved and unrefuted. [I83](iterations/i83-catalan-finite-measure.md) passes original I81 A/B and its conditional criterion without repairs. Its actual integer forms still lack bounded-block noncoincidence; the specified hypergeometric clearing grows at every fixed parameter, while a sufficient gcd saving remains unproved. Parent evidence reproduction passes. C81 is unproved and unrefuted, and parked pending a new mechanism. [I82](iterations/i82-measured-group-operator-discovery.md) gives an author-level polynomial finite-row trace-randomization theorem, classified technical, and precise ergodic-cost and abstract-isomorphism gaps. Parent evidence reproduction passes; no independent analytic verdict is claimed. [I84](iterations/i84-abstract-close-algebras.md) passes the original I82 sequence-algebra criterion without repairs and gives an author proof of abstract nonisomorphism for all positive source parameters. Its characteristic essential ideal and trace representation make arbitrary automorphisms spatial after fixed amplification, preserving the original tensor obstruction. [I87](reviews/i87-abstract-close-algebras-r2.md) passes the original A84 proof for every 0<t<1, both general lemmas and the reused coordinate criterion without repairs, and confirms the technical disposition. Parent evidence reproduction passes; the separate CSSWW passage-locator correction is retained without changing original artifacts. [I88](iterations/i88-nonlinear-banach-discovery.md) gives an exponential coordinate-support bound, qualitative rank divergence and an actual rank-one sparsification obstruction, all author-level technical partials. Parent evidence reproduction passes. Quantitative rank and the coupled absorption/AP construction remain unproved and unrefuted; the finite binary diamond strengthening is rejected by primary literature. [I90](iterations/i90-anchored-rank-approximation.md) passes original I88 A/A′/B without repairs and gives an author proof of an exponential rank bound on the actual finite metric truncations. Weighted pairwise continuation, classical finite-dimensional domination and clipping before local-type transfer replace coordinate-support counting. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I92](reviews/i92-anchored-rank-approximation-r2.md) passes the original Q90 proof, W/E/C and all quantitative variants without repairs, with parent evidence reproduction passing. [I93](reviews/i93-anchored-rank-approximation-novelty-r3.md) classifies the full package as technical via source state-indexed operations, classical Auerbach domination and bounded TV comparison. Parent evidence reproduction passes and I92 resolves its original-proof condition. No count increment. [I94](iterations/i94-topology-transformation-discovery.md) gives author-level technical nonextension and even-tail stabilization results, with parent evidence replay passing. The free involution on the actual marked V#2(S²×S²) remains unproved and unrefuted. [I97](iterations/i97-relative-involution-stabilization.md) passes original A/B without repairs, rules out a geometrically split residual free orbit at count two, and records integral-form and cut-defect constraints as author-level technical partials. Parent evidence replay passes; R94 remains unproved and unrefuted. [I100](iterations/i100-defect-tolerant-topology-obstruction.md) passes original C/D/E and the scoped complement/Whitney claims without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its new technical residual presentation and periodic localization do not improve the stabilization bound, and an exact algebraic counterexample blocks rank-only tensor extensions. R94 remains unproved and unrefuted; the branch is parked pending new geometric control. [I103](iterations/i103-algebraic-complexity-discovery.md) gives complete author-level positive-characteristic rational hitting lists and an every-field 9/4 matrix-multiplication exponent transfer, both classified technical by its concrete source-operation comparison. [I106](iterations/i106-positive-characteristic-imm.md) passes all original constructions and scoped counterexamples without repairs and independently confirms the technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. [I109](iterations/i109-modular-imm-rank.md) passes all original I106 partials and scoped obstructions without repairs and confirms their technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. Its compatible periodic minors and exact excursion-rank decomposition remain too small for the circuit target. The full excursion degeneration has exponentially deficient rank in characteristic two; this is not an upper bound on full IMM rank. The all-prime target remains unproved and unrefuted, and this construction branch is parked. [I112](iterations/i112-inverse-boundary-discovery.md) gives author-level technical cap-transfer, physical-jet lifting and local rigidity results, plus a known-collar uniqueness reduction and scoped gauge/boundary-cost obstructions. Parent evidence replay passes. Arbitrary same-patch recovery of both Lamé coefficients remains unproved/unrefuted; the physical augmented jet space has dimension 32 versus 36 for unrestricted system jets. [I115](iterations/iteration115-physical-elasticity-continuation-task.json) audits these original proofs and pursues constrained continuation and boundary control. [I89](iterations/i89-geometric-group-discovery.md) gives technical proximal-contraction and finite-residual witness deductions; parent evidence reproduction passes. Its used contraction prerequisites pass I91 without repairs; R89 remains outside that independent audit. [I91](iterations/i91-finite-cat0-obstruction.md) passes the used I89 prerequisites without repairs and gives an author proof of explicit finite CAT(0) energy-contraction constants, using fixed-scale midpoint estimates and a retained rational certificate. Parent evidence and exact certificate replays pass. [I95](reviews/i95-finite-cat0-obstruction-r2.md) passes the original Q91 proof and action-to-certificate implication without repairs; parent evidence and independent reconstruction pass. [I96](reviews/i96-finite-cat0-obstruction-novelty-r3.md) classifies the full Q91 theorem as technical through a complete source-operation reduction and a 12-point scalar contradiction; parent evidence replay passes and I95 resolves its proof condition. [I98](iterations/i98-complex-kahler-discovery.md) records author-level technical finite-radius and relative complete-spray constructions, with parent evidence replay passing. The arbitrary K3-family Oka-map target remains unproved and unrefuted; [I102](iterations/i102-relative-k3-oka-construction.md) passes original A98/W98 and both method obstructions without repairs, at the precise reduced-space interpolation scope. Parent evidence replay passes. Its compatible whole-central-slice germ, conditional relative sewing and adaptive exhaustion criterion remain technical; the fixed-domain extension is missing and R98 is parked unproved and unrefuted. [I104](iterations/i104-modular-representation-discovery.md) gives author-level technical equivariant subsection/trace identities, an all-length A5 divisibility estimate, and explicit obstructions to forgetting Frobenius descent data. Parent evidence replay passes; the blockwise Galois Alperin weight target remains unproved and unrefuted. [I108](iterations/i108-galois-tuple-divisibility.md) passes all original I104 claims without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. [I110](iterations/i110-galois-moment-cancellation.md) passes the original finite-moment criterion and constrained-puncture/index claims without repairs; parent replay passes. New exact fixed-label reconstruction, 56 finite moment certificates, a uniform A5×A divisibility bound for odd-order abelian A, and equivariant nontrivial local-point pairing are technical partials. Arbitrary admissible cancellation and G104 remain unproved/unrefuted; the trivial local-point component is unpaid and the branch is parked. [I114](iterations/i114-quantum-information-discovery.md) gives author-level technical thermal-balance trace-distance estimates and an energy-controlled logarithmic information-loss bound. Parent evidence replay passes. Unequal-temperature constrained entropy power stability remains unproved and unrefuted: the entropy-to-balance step is missing, and the linear-qEPI deficit is positive even at its thermal optimizer. [I117](iterations/iteration117-bosonic-entropy-stability-task.json) audits the original proofs and pursues the missing stability mechanism. [I99](iterations/i99-quantitative-arithmetic-patterns-discovery.md) gives author-level joint-kernel estimates, sharp transfer obstructions and a coefficient-explicit counting bridge; parent evidence replay passes. Its uniform nonlinear Roth target remains unproved and unrefuted. [I101](iterations/i101-two-scale-nonlinear-roth.md) passes original A1–A5/B1–B4 and the scoped counterexamples without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its short-window graph bounds, actual parabolic matrix comparison and block-conditioned counts remain technical. C99 is parked unproved and unrefuted pending the precise deterministic block comparison (U). [I107](iterations/i107-rational-tail-attachment.md) passes all original [I105](iterations/i105-chromatic-homotopy-discovery.md) claims without repairs and supplies an author-level full proof of R105: the actual rational tail splits under F4 and over V for every p≥5 and allowed choice, retaining the nonzero middle attachment. Parent evidence replay passes. [I111](reviews/i111-rational-tail-attachment-r2.md) passes every component of the original full proof without repairs, including the uniform limit, actual detector injection and under/over compatibility, and independently confirms its technical disposition. Parent evidence replay passes; R105 is technically closed under the stipulated premises and no finding is added. [I113](iterations/i113-online-optimization-discovery.md) gives an author-level technical one-sample matroid-prophet guarantee of 2⁻²⁹⁵K⁻²⁷ under two-sided likelihood-ratio misspecification, one-sided impossibility examples, and exact stochastic Blackwell policy extraction. Parent evidence replay passes. The law-free c/K guarantee remains unproved and unrefuted; [I116](iterations/iteration116-robust-prophet-continuation-task.json) audits the original proofs and pursues the sharp dependence. No literal presentation or size/runtime bound is claimed. No ninth finding is accepted.

**Resumed on 2026-10-09: [10-finding ledger](TEN-FINDINGS.md); 7 accepted, 3 remaining.** The user requested continuation to ten and project-only public publication after verification. Each candidate needs a complete new bridge and separate proof and significance reviews before it enters the count. I14 is now technical only. [I15 ternary topology](iterations/i15-odd-order-topology-resumed.md) retains proof PASS but is **technical only** after [final significance review](reviews/i15-odd-order-topology-novelty-r3.md): repeated marked-annulus replacement is already available in the source proof. [I17 six-point spherical Ramsey](iterations/i17-fresh-discovery.md) retains full proof PASS but is **technical only** after [final significance review](reviews/i17-six-point-ramsey-novelty-r3.md): two elementary adjugate lifts and their product supply the certificate. No exact duplicate or new gap is claimed. [I18](iterations/i18-joint-prime-neighbors.md) is a verified gap record with no count increment. [I19](iterations/i19-fresh-structural-discovery.md) supplies a technical signed Saxl quotient with a precise remaining gap; [I21](iterations/i21-signed-saxl-dominance.md) constructs signed maps but finds a required constituent missing and proves fixed-width limits. That route is parked; [I24 completes its resumed investigation](iterations/i24-elementary-unimodality-resumed.md): relevant history jumps are finite and centered, but the character-positivity and Lefschetz gaps remain. [I20](iterations/i20-pde-kinetic-discovery.md) records kinetic selection and fluctuation gaps with verified technical initial-law deductions; [I23](iterations/i23-kinetic-connected-fluctuations.md) develops component bounds but leaves normalized signed-history summation unresolved; [I26](iterations/i26-probability-discovery-resumed.md) completes a three-target probability screen but leaves the integer-height interface limit unproved; [I22](iterations/i22-combinatorial-discovery.md) records technical entropy/prophet deductions and unresolved general targets. [I25 is accepted as R011](findings/R011-rooted-matching-entropy.md), the fifth substantial finding: the rooted coefficient-3/2 theorem passes independent full-proof and significance reviews plus parent verification.

**Fourth substantial deduction accepted:** [R010](findings/R010-complex-modes-PD-independence.md) proves joint uniformity of Omega(p-1) modulo every fixed m and independence from the PD(1) ranked-factor law in fixed reduced progressions. Both independent reviews pass, and parent checks reproduce. The common nonzero principal model and its signed recombination supply the additional argument beyond parity. The pause at four ended with the user's explicit resumption on 2026-10-09; the ten-finding target remains incomplete.

The [sharp spectral-width candidate](iterations/i14-sharp-spectral-width.md) retains its [independent proof PASS](reviews/i14-sharp-spectral-width-r2.md), but the [final significance review](reviews/i14-spectral-width-novelty-r3.md) classifies it as **technical only**. Chai–Sun's general local weighted estimate supplies the altered surface input; the full graph construction comes from the pinned source, and the remaining collar check is an elementary extension of its quadratic argument. This is neither an exact-duplicate claim nor a new proof gap. Parent checks verify 9,416 sealed artifacts, 33 unchanged frozen inputs, all 9,340 pinned text files and ten exact algebraic identities. No count increment is assigned.

The [arbitrary-rank topology construction](iterations/i07-structures.md) retains its proof PASS but is **technical only** after [final significance review](reviews/i07-structures-novelty-r3.md): cyclic-cover reduction and replication over all binary directions supply the main rank conclusion. Parent diagnostics and the artifact seal reproduce. It does not increment the substantial-finding count.

**Third substantial deduction accepted:** [R009](findings/R009-variable-channel-capacity.md) proves the variable-channel four-state weighted-capacity criterion, including locally finite trees and universal information bounds. Proof, significance and extension audits pass; parent checks reproduce. This is one finding, including all degree and zero-edge extensions.

**Second substantial deduction accepted:** [Iteration 05](iterations/README.md#iteration-05--second-substantial-result-accepted) meets the user's request for another result after R006 through R008, on the stipulated-corpus and bounded novelty basis. The simultaneous-root lane made [partial scalar progress](iterations/i06-cubic-reservoir.md), but its explicit rough-correlation estimate and cubic reservoir remain unproved; that lane is parked at the stated gap.

The [parity result R008](findings/R008-parity-PD-independence.md) gives full Liouville cancellation jointly with PD(1) and squarefreeness in every fixed reduced progression. Independent analytic and final significance reviews support acceptance, and parent checks reproduce. It implies Moree–Hommersom Conjecture 1 with finitely prescribed valuations. The final record includes current-version prior-art corrections and retains the limit that worldwide priority is unverified.

The [cross-field Gaussian proof](iterations/i05-crossfield.md) passes [mathematical review](reviews/i05-crossfield-r2.md), but is demoted on the contribution gate: classical Banach-valued Gaussian decoupling already supplies its central step, and the result needs no corpus input. It is retained as a correct application, with exact publication priority unverified, and is not counted as a substantial new finding.

**The continued iterations reached a substantial result under the accepted-corpus premise.** The [iteration record](iterations/README.md) documents the search and acceptance decision. The [first-pass outcome](OUTCOME.md) records the previous unsuccessful search and remains historical. [R006](findings/R006-progression-PD-primitive-root-density.md) now has a complete, independently reviewed deduction of positive-proportion primitive roots for every admissible fixed base under the accepted corpus. The final review supports the substantive/nonroutine gate. Worldwide priority and the exact Artin density formula remain unproved. Working reports are provisional until reviewed and integrated. The immutable source revision is recorded in [../sources/upstream.json](../sources/upstream.json).

- **Arithmetic:** the [second round](reviews/arithmetic-bridge-r2.md) proves that one proposed four-cycle is harmless and that the naive global unweighted operator norm fails. The full high-trace and cubic-centering estimates remain missing. This route is parked pending a genuinely new joint estimate; it is not being counted as a Chowla result.

- **Discrete:** the [scout](scouts/discrete.md) found obstructions to union-preserving coding and graph balancing. The [direct-noise round](reviews/frankl-direct-r2.md) produced no Frankl advance and is parked. Parent review corrected its overclaim of general falsification and its vacuous endpoint-supremum candidate. Both finite experiment outputs were reproduced exactly; floating-point evidence is not proof.

- **Analysis:** the [simple-eigenvalue hot-spots extension](scouts/analysis.md) survived [mathematical review](reviews/hotspots-review-r2.md) after repairs, but was **demoted for lack of a novel mechanism**. The subsequent [polygon candidate](reviews/hotspots-multiplicity-r2.md), covering repeated eigenvalues, has also been **demoted on significance and novelty grounds** by the [round-3 review](reviews/hotspots-polygon-novelty-r3.md): the smooth mechanism and polarization are already published, leaving only a short corner extension of unconfirmed priority. Both that reviewer and the [dedicated proof reviewer](reviews/hotspots-polygon-proof-r3.md) accepted the mathematics after analytic clarifications. The parent reproduced the exact checks and recorded the result as [technical finding R003](findings/R003-polygon-eigenline-selection.md). General Lipschitz eigenline selection remains open. Neither result fulfills the user's research objective.

- **Algebraic geometry:** the [K3 audit](reviews/geometry-k3-review-r2.md) accepts the corrected arithmetic comparison but gives a CM counterexample to its interpretation as the full known Hodge region; Lemma C is Varesco 2023. The [Mumford audit](reviews/geometry-mumford-review-r2.md) validates a repaired reduction but finds exact prior art. Neither establishes new substantive Hodge progress. The parent reproduced both independent audits and source hashes. The [construction round](reviews/geometry-mumford-bridge-r2.md) found no cycles. It proposes a split-sixfold partner and a conditional linking-class reduction; the [final audit](reviews/geometry-partner-review-r3.md) accepts a repaired classical construction and conditional reduction, with novelty unverified. The algebraic link remains unconstructed. No major new theorem is claimed.
